ينتحرون (form VIII)
# يَنْتَحِرُونَ (yantaḥirūna) /jan.ta.ħi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# يُنْتَحَرُونَ (yuntaḥarūna) /jun.ta.ħa.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
